metadata.description: HarnessFlow — a harness that drives AI coding agents from a raw idea to a working app: product-layer shaping, main-chain discipline (SDD + TDD), mechanical gates, demo-gated acceptance, and pluggable ext-* domain extensions.

plugins.name: harness-flow
plugins.description: HarnessFlow v4.0.0: drives agents from a raw idea to a working app. 9 core skills: hf-shape turns an idea into a product layer (product.md, decisions.md, an assumptions ledger, a vertical-slice backlog) via structured interview and opinionated stack presets; hf-skeleton makes slice S-1 a walking skeleton; then each slice runs the risk-tiered delivery chain frame -> plan -> build -> verify -> ship (hf-frame, hf-plan, hf-build TDD, hf-verify with demo-gated user acceptance, hf-review with independent-context discipline, hf-ship with feedback write-back). Exploration mode (frame -> build -> close) covers disposable prototypes that can never ship. A stdlib-only mechanical gate (skills/hf-workflow/scripts/hf_gate.py: init/status/next/run/check) produces tamper-evident evidence logs and adjudicates every transition from files, verdict lines, exit codes and timestamps; hf_gate.py status cold-starts any session. Domain skills plug in as ext-* extensions loaded per stage (ext-ui-design and ext-cpp ship as seeds). Installs to Cursor/OpenCode via stdlib install.py (copy/symlink) with thin install.sh/install.ps1 wrappers.
